The '''Tantel armor''' was a model of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used mainly prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> It offered a high degree of protection against energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but lesser protection from kinetic damage.<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The complete armor set included helmet, breastplate, left and right biceps, left and right bracers, gloves, leggings and boots.<ref name="SWG" /> The helmet was adorned with [[Gondar/Legends|gondar]] tusks.<ref name="TC:TToJC">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> The armor set was available in several colors.<ref name="SWG" />

Variants of this armor were the '''Rogue armor''' sometimes used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and the '''First Responder armor''' appreciated by [[Medic/Legends|medics]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==History==
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Tantel armor was rarely used and considered an ancient type.<ref name="SWG" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], while using the alias "Tamtel Skreej," wore a set of this armor during his attempt to [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|rescue]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="RotJ" />
